## Hellcrown (CR 1)

**XP** 400  
LE Tiny undead  
**Init** +4; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., Perception +6  


**Defense**


**AC** 16, touch 16, flat-footed 12 (+4 Dex, +2 size)  
**hp** 22 (2d8+6)  
**Fort** +3, **Ref** +4, **Will** +4  
**Immune** undead traits  


**Offense**


**Speed** fly 30 ft  
**Ranged** Nail +7 (1d6-1 plus bleeding nail)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 9, **Dex** 18, **Con** -, **Int** 9, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 17  
**Base Atk** +1; **CMB** -1, **CMD** 13  
**Feats** Rapid Shot, Flyby Attack  
**Skills** Fly +13, Intimidate +8, Perception +6, Stealth +12  
**Languages** Common, Infernal  

**Bleeding Nail (Ex)** A Hellcrown attacks by throwing nails. These nails are ranged attacks with a 20 ft. range increment. If a Hellcrown hits with a nail, the target takes 1 point of bleed damage and 1 point of strength damage unless it succeeds on a DC 14 fortitude save. Multiple nail strikes stack. As a move action, a creature can remove the nail to end the bleed damage and remove the strength damage.  

**Terrifying Stare (Su)** As a swift action the Hellcrown can terrifying nearby foes. All foes that can see the Hellcrown that are currently suffering from its bleeding nail must attempt a DC 14 will save or become frightened for 1 round. Once a creature has been subjected to this ability, it cannot be subjected again for at least 10 minutes. This is a mind-affecting fear effect.
